claims.context: Final Design Completion Date contractual milestone
Actual 100% Submittal date on the BOD document itself

conflict_flags.rationale: The SOW was an early-contract planning document setting schedule milestones. The BOD dated 08 September 2025 is the actual 100% submittal, representing the real design completion approximately 21 months after the contractual milestone. The actual date is more useful for past-performance purposes.

claims.context: Estimated Construction Completion Date in early contract planning
Gantt chart shows construction activities spanning 2026–2027 with all specific start/finish dates left blank at 100% design submittal stage

conflict_flags.rationale: The SOW-stated Dec 2024 construction completion was clearly superseded given design wasn't complete until Sep 2025. The BOD Appendix C schedule shows 2026–2027 construction windows but no specific dates were filled in. Construction completion date is not determinable from available sources.
